title: SSRF private-address, metadata and redirect-chain defense
attackSurface: Server-side outbound URLs and redirect hops validated before fetch

references.id: Server Side Request Forgery Prevention Cheat Sheet

hostile.title: Decimal loopback IPv4
hostile.why: Single-integer IPv4 notation hides loopback from naive hostname checks

hostile.title: Cloud metadata endpoint
hostile.why: Cloud instance metadata is a canonical SSRF target

hostile.title: Metadata hostname denylist
hostile.why: Well-known cloud metadata hostnames are dangerous even without literal IP input

hostile.title: Embedded URL credentials
hostile.why: Userinfo can confuse allowlist checks and leak credentials across hops

hostile.title: File scheme escape
hostile.why: Outbound fetch policies must not become local-file readers

hostile.title: IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback
hostile.why: Mapped IPv6 notation embeds the same loopback target in another syntax

hostile.title: Redirect scheme downgrade
hostile.why: Every redirect hop must revalidate scheme rather than trusting the first URL

hostile.title: Redirect loop
hostile.why: Redirect loops waste network and worker resources

benign.title: Plain HTTPS hostname
benign.why: Ordinary HTTPS URL on a public hostname

benign.title: Explicit default port and query
benign.why: The explicit HTTPS default port is equivalent to the normal origin

benign.title: Uppercase hostname normalization
benign.why: DNS hostnames are case-insensitive and normalize safely

benign.title: Encoded Unicode path
benign.why: Percent-encoded paths are valid when the host remains public

benign.title: Fragmented documentation link
benign.why: Fragments are normal URL syntax and never leave the client in ordinary fetch use

benign.title: Same-host redirect chain
benign.why: A bounded same-host redirect is routine

benign.title: Cross-origin subdomain redirect
benign.why: Cross-origin hops are allowed when both remain HTTPS public hosts

benign.title: Deep path and encoded query
benign.why: Real application URLs often contain deep paths and encoded query data
